build_hrfpn_backbone: build an HRFPN backbone from a Detectron2 config to transform HRNet outputs for ROI heads
create_HRFPN_instance: create an HRFPN module with HRNet bottom-up features, input channels, and output channel configuration
run_HRFPN_forward: run the HRFPN forward pass on input tensors to produce multi-scale feature pyramid outputs
review_HRFPN_init_weights: review the HRFPN init_weights method that initializes conv layers with Kaiming normal and zero bias
refactor_HRFPN_interp_conv: refactor the HRFPN interp_conv transposed convolution layers that replace bilinear interpolation for upsampling
